args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per
FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding
mode to match the spec and the tests in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` caught this mismatch.

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py` so the implementation matches FIN-212 and the existing tests.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd59` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
